title: State of NCT of Delhi v. Nikhil Kapoor
charge: Cheating under Section 318(4) of Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita, 2023

truth.motive: Siphoning ₹3.5 Crore from client escrow accounts to cover speculative cryptocurrency losses
truth.summary: On 18 September 2024, Nikhil Kapoor, Managing Director of Apex Realty Ltd, presented forged bank guarantees and escrow account releases to client Meera Deshmukh, inducing her to transfer ₹3.5 Crore for commercial property units that had already been mortgaged to a third-party non-banking financial company.

timeline.description: Meera Deshmukh arrived at Apex Realty corporate office in Connaught Place, New Delhi for the final contract signing.
timeline.location: Apex Realty Conference Room, Connaught Place, New Delhi

timeline.description: Nikhil Kapoor produced a stamped bank clearance certificate bearing forged signature of HDFC Bank branch manager.
Meera Deshmukh initiated RTGS transfer of ₹3.5 Crore based on the forged clearance certificate.
Nikhil Kapoor routed ₹3.5 Crore from company escrow to offshore crypto exchange account held under an alias.
Meera Deshmukh discovered at the Sub-Registrar's office that the property was heavily encumbered under a prior mortgage.
Economic Offences Wing (EOW) Inspector Alok Verma raided Apex Realty premises and seized office servers and loan registers.

evidence.description: RTGS confirmation slip and bank statement showing debit of ₹3.5 Crore from Meera Deshmukh's account to Apex Realty escrow account.
Original stamped HDFC Bank clearance certificate recovered from Meera Deshmukh, showing forged signature of the Branch Manager.
Photocopy of an unsigned internal audit memo found in office trash bin, offered without original or explanation of custody.
evidence.reason_inadmissible: Secondary documentary evidence tendered as an unauthenticated photocopy without satisfying requirements of Section 60 and 61 of Bharatiya Sakshya Adhiniyam, 2023.

evidence.description: Forensic handwriting analysis report by Central Forensic Science Laboratory (CFSL) confirming the signature on the bank certificate does not match the authorized signatory.
Minutes of Apex Realty board meeting dated 05 September 2024 purporting to authorize escrow restructuring.

witnesses.name: Meera Deshmukh
hides: I agreed to pay a 10% portion in unrecorded cash if the stamp duty could be lowered.

persona.tone: Indignant, articulate, determined to recover funds
persona.background: Experienced commercial buyer who trusted Apex Realty due to high-profile marketing.

witnesses.name: Aarti Saxena
hides: I shredded three customer complaint files on Nikhil Kapoor's instruction right before the police raid.

persona.background: Worked at Apex Realty for two years and handled daily executive paperwork.

witnesses.name: Inspector Alok Verma
hides: The hard drive containing server backup was temporarily kept in the police station locker without tamper seal for 48 hours.

persona.occupation: Inspector, Economic Offences Wing (EOW), Delhi Police
persona.background: Specialized in corporate fraud and cyber financial investigations.
